Boiler servicing

From £89. Book an appointment or request a quote; we cover Bristol and Bath.

What a service visit covers

A standard service takes about an hour. The engineer inspects the boiler casing and seals, checks the flue and the ventilation around the appliance, tests the gas pressure and the combustion with a flue-gas analyser, cleans the burner and the heat exchanger where the manufacturer recommends it, and checks the safety devices. You receive a written report and a service record for the boiler, which most manufacturers require for the warranty to remain valid.

Appointments are available on weekdays between eight and six, with a two-hour arrival window confirmed by text the evening before. If the engineer finds a fault that needs a part, the repair is quoted separately before any work is done. Landlord safety certificates can be issued during the same visit for an additional fee.
